_how: Hand-entered facts that have no free data feed. The update script reads this file. 'series' = all-time regular-season record vs a team through the end of the 'thru' season (games after that are added automatically). 'games' = extras for one game, keyed by nflverse game id (e.g. TV network; 'analyst' = the TV game analyst, which names him in the gameday chart and turns on the Shut up, Collinsworth button). 'vsBest' = Allen holds the best career win % vs a team among QBs with at least 'min' regular-season games; 'playoffs' true counts playoff games too; 'next' is the runner-up, 'bg' the share image key. It shows on the records watch once his games vs them (counting the next one) reach 'min'.
